comments.text:
All of you guys are confused about life cycle of battery !! including the person making this video ... 
i shall explain in gist :- 
Batteries depend not one ONE but not TWO But THREE factors 
CYcle and calendar ageing  and C rating of charge/discharge 

1) one charge cycle/ one full charge cycle(FCE) is when the battery charges and discharges from 100% to 0% ..aka depth of discharge (DOD ) 
so 1FCE is =100%DOD 
SO if you use this format for charging you will get approx 500 FCE

now If i charge from 50%-100% and do DOD of 50% and maintain this cycle 
then charging again with the same cycle  is not 1FCE like the youtuber is explaining 

infact your cycle life increases 
Doing a DOD of 100% gives approx 500FCE but 
Doing a DOD of 50% will give you approx 2000FCE 
Doing a DOD of 30% will give you 5000FCE

then is calendar ageing
the given data is for 1 year at 25 deg C
 .. storing at 100SOC (state of charge ) battery causes 12-15% degredation every year 
Storing at 40% SOC causes 4% degredation every year 
Storing at 20% SOC causes 1.5-2% degredation every year 

LI batteries are rendered usless upon 30% degredation 

SO IF YOU MAINTAIN YOUR BATTERY PROPERLY AND USE PROPER CHARGING CYCLE U CAN MAKE IT LAST FOR 10-15 YEARS
